dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Gradual, symmetrical 2D narrowing of the visible torso from the mid-section toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Generally smooth lateral margins with a slight asymmetrical outward curvature on the mid-left flank compared to the relatively linear right margin.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Median intensity corresponds to a light-grey to off-white primary skin tone.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-frequency, diffuse darker grey pigmentation patches are distributed across the anterior dorsal area and along the lateral margins.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Very diffuse gradient slopes observed between pigmented and depigmented skin regions.
